description: This file defines a Flutter widget called FilterChipRow that displays a horizontally scrollable list of filter chips. It manages selected state externally and contains an internal widget _OceanFilterChip for individual chips with customizable appearance and tap handling.

classes.name: FilterChipRow
classes.description: A stateless widget that lays out filter chips horizontally, highlighting the active one and notifying changes via a callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for FilterChipRow, rendering a scrollable row of filter chips based on provided labels and active selection.

methods.name: _OceanFilterChip
methods.description: A private stateless widget representing an individual filter chip with customizable style and tap behavior.

methods.name: _OceanFilterChip.build
methods.description: Builds the widget for an individual filter chip, styling it based on selection state and handling tap events.
